verdict.rationale: Qodo documents pre-PR local review: the Agentic Toolbox CLI can "review changes before opening a pull request." The Toolbox also brings Qodo's review capabilities into existing coding agents, with plugins for Claude Code, Codex and Kiro and an MCP server for custom agents. This reaches the editor indirectly, through a CLI or a third-party agent. The evidence shows no native IDE extension and no proof that the local review matches the PR review. Missing for 10: a first-party IDE extension (e.g., VS Code/JetBrains), documented parity between the in-editor review and the PR review, and hands-on or independent corroboration of the pre-push workflow.
